name: stt-web-app
description: Speech-to-Text Web Application using MERN Stack

scripts.dev: echo 'Start these in separate terminals:' && echo '1. cd server && node index.js' && echo '2. cd client && npm run dev'
scripts.start-dev: concurrently "cd server && node index.js" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.server:test: cd server && node -e "console.log('Testing MongoDB connection...'); const mongoose = require('mongoose'); const uri = require('dotenv').config().parsed.MONGODB_URI; mongoose.connect(uri).then(() => { console.log('✅ MongoDB connected'); process.exit(0); }).catch(err => { console.error('❌ Connection failed:', err.message); process.exit(1); });"
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules && npm install
